title: LISBOA (Lisbon Itinerary System Based On AI): source code and evaluation artifacts
description:
LISBOA is a multi-agent assistant for context-aware tourism and urban mobility guidance in Lisbon. A supervisor routes each request to specialized worker agents (weather, transport, research), an optional itinerary planner, and a quality-assurance stage. The agents use 45 grounded tools connected to nine Lisbon data sources, combining retrieval-augmented generation, geospatial open-data retrieval, and live weather and transport integrations.

This record archives the source code, the evaluation corpus, and the evaluation results (worker benchmark, paired ablation, and statistics) reported in the article published in Results in Engineering (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rineng.2026.113369) and in the MSc thesis at NOVA Information Management School (NOVA IMS), Universidade NOVA de Lisboa.
